title: Balance Leveling and Sharpening
description: To keep memories accurate: - Write details down: Capture events as soon as possible to avoid losing information. - Check for gaps: Ask yourself what might be missing in your memory. - Avoid exaggeration: Be mindful of which details you emphasize when retelling stories. Example: After a meeting, jot down key points immediately before memories get distorted.
